Again,Ⓒadv.ⒹpunaH, BUyaH; ‘a(gain) and a(gain)’ BUyo BUyaH, vAraMvAraM; ‘as much a(gain)’ dviguRa a.

 3 (With verbs) by prati pr.

Against,Ⓒprep.Ⓓprati-ABi pr. to nouns; prativAtaM ‘a(gainst) the wind’ &c.
Ⓑ
 2 aBimuKaM, pratimuKaM, saMmuKaM, in comp. or with gen.
Ⓑ
 3 virudDaM, pratikUlaM, or by atikramya; ‘a(gainst) my order’ mama SAsanasya virudDaM, SAsanamatikramya-ullaMGya; ‘assist him a(gainst) his brother’ BrAtari badDavErasya tasya sAhAyyaM kuru.
Ⓑ
 4 arTe, arTaM; ApadarTe DanaM rakzet ‘should lay by wealth a(gainst) (as a provision for) calamities’.
Agape,Ⓒa.ⒹjfMBamARa; ‘with eyes a(gape) with astonishment’ vismayotPullalocana.
